title: Cisco Catalyst Center operations
description: Mirror Catalyst Center Assurance in Splunk: devices that drop out, P1 and P2 issues, unhealthy devices and access points, overall network and client health, unexpected reboots, and a check that the add-on is still collecting.

requiredData.notes: Enable the devicehealth, issue, networkhealth, and clienthealth Intent API inputs in TA_cisco_catalyst. Assurance health scores need a Catalyst Center DNA Advantage licence (a Cisco licence, not a second Splunk app).

industrySources.control: Assurance Overall Enterprise Health: network device, wired/wireless client scores, Top 10 issue types from P1
Global issue settings: Assurance issues are the paging signal

curationNotes: Skips UC-5.13.14 client onboarding (per-client feed; DHCP false positives on static-IP estates) and UC-5.13.65 event notifications (Issues are the vendor paging list).
Skips Site Analytics (needs Cisco AI Network Analytics), ITSI service models, and ISE / SD-WAN / Meraki / ThousandEyes correlation UCs.
Several steps list baseline prerequisites (UC-5.13.1, 5.13.9, 5.13.16, 5.13.21) that are not in the pack; decide whether to add them or relax the prerequisite before publishing.
